Given the sketch of a polynomial $p(x)$ above, find the solution to $p(x)\ge 0.$

$x\in [$
{{field-1}}$,$
{{field-2}}$)$
worked_solution:
To solve the inequality $p(x)\ge 0,$ we need to find the values of $x$ for which the curve $y=p(x)$ lies above the $x$-axis or touches this axis. 

Based on the graph, the solution is 
$x\in [-1,\infty ).$
